description: Exploratory paired whole-process trials on Windows x64. Each stage compares against the previous primitives SDK. Designs and host load differ between stages.

pilot2.change: runtime-dispatched AVX-512 search, copy and overlapping move up to 128 KiB, Windows fast_float and AVX2 UTF-8

pilot3.change: original list search, 512 B to 16 KiB wide copy, move and fill, compact native string metadata

pilot4.change: original overlapping move restored, separate null branch for string equality; before final cleanup of disjoint copy

wide-transfer-pinned.change: Rejected 512 B to 16 KiB AVX-512 disjoint copy and fill with CRT memmove. All 33 workloads.

wide-transfer-scheduled.change: Rejected 512 B to 16 KiB AVX-512 disjoint copy and fill with CRT memmove. All 33 workloads.
